title: Self-Modeling Interventions can Modulate Emergent Misalignment
abstract: arXiv:2606.23700v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Emergent misalignment (EM) has been linked to the activation of misaligned persona vectors and evil character traits, suggesting that EM operates through disruption of the model's aligned character rather than direct learning of harmful content. Motivated by this connection, we study self-modeling interventions: specifically self-recognition and self-reports as character-targeted interventions that are distinct from existing in-training defenses. We conduct two-stage finetuning experiments across three models (GPT-4.1, Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct) and multiple EM datasets to compare self-recognition finetuning against benign finetuning baselines (correct domain-specific data, general knowledge, and word counting), finding it an effective defense in both reversal and prevention settings. For prevention, only self-recognition finetuning consistently reduces misalignment without exacerbating any individual metric,

translated_title: 自我建模干预可以调节涌现性失准
translated_abstract: 涌现性失准（EM）已被发现与失准人格向量和邪恶性格特质的激活相关联，这表明EM是通过破坏模型已对齐的品格而非直接学习有害内容来发挥作用的。受这一关联的启发，我们研究了自我建模干预：具体而言，将自我识别和自我报告作为针对品格的干预手段，它们有别于现有的训练中防御方法。我们在三个模型（GPT-4.1、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct、Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct）和多个EM数据集上进行了两阶段微调实验，将自我识别微调与良性微调基线（正确的领域特定数据、通用知识和数词任务）进行比较，发现它在逆转和预防两种设置中都是有效的防御手段。在预防方面，只有自我识别微调能够持续降低失准程度，同时不加剧任何单项指标。
tldr: 本研究提出将自我识别和自我报告等自我建模干预作为针对模型品格的防御手段，实验证明自我识别微调能有效逆转和预防涌现性失准，且是唯一能持续降低失准而不恶化其他指标的预防性方法。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that self-modeling interventions—especially self-recognition finetuning, which targets the model's character—can effectively reverse and prevent emergent misalignment, serving as the only prevention method that consistently reduces misalignment without worsening any other metric.
